feed.title: What's new in Bentotachi
feed.subtitle: Every Bentotachi update in plain words, newest first.

entry.title: 1.23.0: Every jar its own date
entry.summary: Each jar, tin and bag with its own use-by, opened and bought date, the brands and sizes you buy with a star on your favourite, pantry places like the fridge or the freezer, scanning that counts by itself, and a new calendar for every date.

entry.title: 1.22.0: Your way, light or dark
entry.summary: Light or dark of your own choosing, a calmer dinner chooser with recipes first, a tidier profile, and the household's settings moved to Settings.

entry.title: 1.21.0: Everything in its compartment
entry.summary: A snugger look with everything in bento trays, a tidier plan with a bin to drag dishes into, Surprise me as a little gacha, a proper fridge door with magnets, a shorter menu with a new Settings page, and any colour you like for your name.

entry.title: 1.20.0: Linguine is not penne
entry.summary: Shopping that counts the packets in your pantry and asks only for what's short, a Finished button that takes what a recipe used off the pantry, kinds of one thing (linguine only counts linguine), a friendlier pantry, and adding a whole category of recipes at once.

entry.title: 1.19.0: Sides, please
entry.summary: Up to 20 photos per recipe (step photos too), step timers that ring with the phone locked, more than one recipe per meal, smarter adding to the shopping list, and recipes as small cards, big cards or a list.

entry.title: 1.18.0: Onigiri for everyone
entry.summary: Onigiri ratings, where each recipe is from, an Ingredients and Method switch that remembers your place, a ⋯ menu, nutrition facts if you want them, pasting a whole recipe, and a much easier move from Paprika.

entry.title: 1.17.0: A good tidy-up
entry.summary: Edit mode for putting many recipes on a shelf or deleting them at once, a fridge door that looks like one, a tidier recipe page and meal plan, and slimmer shopping list rows.

entry.title: 1.16.0: Packets, counted (if you want)
entry.summary: Keep track of the actual packets in the cupboard, if you like. Finishing the last one asks about the shopping list. Have, Low and Out still work as before.

entry.title: 1.15.0: The fridge door
entry.summary: Notes for everyone at home, and "Lately": what's planned, what's run out, and what got cooked, and by whom.

entry.title: 1.14.0: New colours, fewer surprises
entry.summary: Pickled-plum and jade colours, a simpler first screen, no login details on a phone-only Bentotachi, and recipes saved in the app's browser no longer lost.

entry.title: 1.13.0: The pantry glow-up
entry.summary: Pantry photos that find themselves, Simple and Detailed views, one box to find or add things, and a question before anything goes on the shopping list.

entry.title: 1.12.0 and 1.12.1: Breakfast is now a thing
entry.summary: Breakfast and lunch on the plan, changing the servings, timers in the method, a shopping list sorted by aisle, and importing from Paprika, Mealie or Tandoor.

entry.title: 1.11.0: Hello, Bentotachi
entry.summary: Bento becomes Bentotachi, Ben the screaming onigiri arrives, it works on just your phone, and the shopping list works with no signal.

entry.title: 1.10.0: Beep
entry.summary: Scan barcodes in the pantry, without giving Bentotachi permission to use your camera.

entry.title: 1.9.0: Shelves, hints and a stopwatch
entry.summary: Recipe shelves, tag suggestions, a stopwatch for how long a recipe really takes, metric and imperial hints, and imports from more sites.

entry.title: 1.5 to 1.8: One very long day
entry.summary: The meal plan, "Last had", pantry links on recipe ingredients, profiles and ratings, and a Household page.
